name: TrackGenie
author: trackgenie

sections.description:
TrackGenie plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the TrackGenie platform for shipment tracking. Once connected, TrackGenie automatically syncs orders from your store. Store owners can manage tracking information from the WordPress admin.

Features:

  • Automatic order synchronization with TrackGenie platform
  • Shipment tracking data capture and management
  • Support for 1,000+ carriers worldwide
  • Real-time tracking status updates
  • OAuth-based secure authentication
  • Admin settings panel for easy configuration
  • Order metabox with tracking information
  • WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible

Requirements:

  • WooCommerce 8.2 or later must be installed and active
  • Active TrackGenie account (sign up at trackgenie.io)

Privacy & Data Collection:

This plugin connects to the TrackGenie service (trackgenie.io) to sync order data and retrieve shipment tracking information. By installing and configuring this plugin, you consent to:

  • Sending order data (order number, customer info, shipping details) to TrackGenie servers
  • Receiving tracking updates from TrackGenie API
  • OAuth authentication with your TrackGenie account

View TrackGenie’s privacy policy at https://trackgenie.io/privacy-policy

Support:

For plugin support, visit our support forum or contact us through TrackGenie Documentation.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce (required).
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/trackgenie directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Go to the top-level TrackGenie menu in your WordPress admin to connect your store.
  5. Click “Connect to TrackGenie” and follow the OAuth authentication flow.
  6. Once connected, your orders will automatically sync with TrackGenie.
sections.faq:
Does TrackGenie require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active for this plugin to work.

How do I connect my store to TrackGenie?

Navigate to the top-level TrackGenie menu in your WordPress admin. Click “Connect to TrackGenie” and follow the OAuth pairing flow to authenticate with your TrackGenie account.

Do I need a TrackGenie account?

Yes. You need an active TrackGenie account. Sign up at trackgenie.io if you haven’t already.

Which carriers does TrackGenie support?

TrackGenie supports over 1,000 carriers worldwide including USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL, Canada Post, Royal Mail, and many more.

Is my data secure?

Yes. TrackGenie uses OAuth 2.0 for secure authentication and all data is transmitted over encrypted HTTPS connections. View our privacy policy at trackgenie.io/privacy-policy.

Does this work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. TrackGenie is fully compatible with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

How do I get support?

For plugin support, visit the WordPress support forum. For TrackGenie platform support, visit docs.trackgenie.io.
